title: AppsFlyer Pricing 2026: Plans, Tiers & Costs | metacto

facts.fact: The metacto guide says AppsFlyer's free Zero plan is limited to apps with up to 12,000 lifetime non-organic installs.
The metacto guide says AppsFlyer's Growth plan costs $0.07 per conversion after the Welcome Package.
facts.quote: after your Welcome Package of 12,000 free conversions.

facts.fact: The metacto guide says the Welcome Package includes 12,000 free conversions to use within the first 12 months.
facts.quote: 12,000 free conversions to use within your first 12 months

facts.fact: The metacto guide says the Enterprise plan is custom-priced at $0.03-$0.05 per conversion after negotiation.
The metacto guide says that as of February 2026, connected TV, PC, and console platform installs are also charged at the $0.07 rate on the Growth plan.
facts.quote: As of February 2026, connected TV, PC, and console platform installs are also charged at the $0.07 rate.

facts.fact: The metacto guide gives an example Growth plan annual cost of about $42,000 per year at 50K monthly conversions.
The metacto guide gives an example Growth plan annual cost of about $84,000 per year at 100K monthly conversions.
The metacto guide gives an example Growth plan annual cost of about $168,000 per year at 200K monthly conversions.
The metacto guide says Growth plan custom dashboards cost $5,000-$30,000 per year as premium add-ons.
The metacto guide says the advanced fraud suite add-on costs $10,000-$50,000+ per year.
The metacto guide says the Growth plan's Raw Data API has a 1M row limit, and full Data Locker access requires Enterprise.
facts.quote: Raw Data API with 1M row limit

facts.fact: The metacto guide says the Enterprise plan includes a dedicated customer success manager with a 2-hour SLA.
The metacto guide describes the Enterprise plan as best for large-scale advertisers with 1M+ conversions.
The metacto guide says the Zero plan includes a 30-day trial of premium add-ons.
facts.quote: plus a 30-day trial of premium add-ons

facts.fact: The metacto guide says the Growth plan supports tracking across all media sources and 90+ partner integrations.
The metacto guide says the Zero plan's SKAN 4.0 dashboard has three postback windows.
The metacto guide says AppsFlyer's pricing is primarily based on the number of non-organic app installs (conversions) tracked per month.
facts.quote: AppsFlyer’s pricing is primarily based on the number of non-organic app installs (conversions) you track per month.

facts.fact: The metacto guide states it reflects AppsFlyer's pricing structure as updated in May 2026.
facts.quote: This guide reflects AppsFlyer’s current pricing structure, including the latest conversion rates

facts.fact: The metacto guide was published on August 31, 2025.
